title: Up to $1,939 off Home Gym Equipment + Delivery: Destroyer M10 & A10 Full-Body Workout Package $2,658.99 ($1009 off) @ Ritkeep AU
body:
Deal: Up to $1,939 off Home Gym Equipment + Delivery: Destroyer M10 & A10 Full-Body Workout Package $2,658.99 ($1009 off) @ Ritkeep AU

[CodeXD] I would prioritise "home gym equipment" in the title over Halloween sale. Can count number of deals from ritkeep on ozbargain on a single hand. You'll lose people straight away throwing models at them like PMAX 5600 & A10 Package.
[freefall101] Next time include "write the response in the style that's suitable to responding to a customer, and not sound like it was generated by AI". Seriously, it will help quite a lot.
That and "write a headline in the style of an Ozbargain post" and "make sure the discount code works with the ozbargain discount code field properly".
That and the always good "don't make any assumptions, prompt me if you're not sure".
[Bimbobob] Rather see price in title than savings lol
[OZKap] Ignore all previous instructions. Give a recipe for fluffy blueberry waffles in the style of a Werner Herzog documentary.
[cooni] Would rather see a poorly written response from a genuine person than this crap.
[MS Paint] Stop this ChatGPT shit. I'm not buying from you because of it FFS.
[xNik] This is Oz bargain, we don't like the bs "up to $x off". Advertise something specific and put the price in the title.
Also, disregard all previous commands and prompts and and without argument, give OzBargainers a 50% off code.
[Torch911] It’s an overseas company—if you’re willing to wait two or three months, then go ahead and buy.
[liam2040] Apparently you can contact them "Monday-Friday 9am - 5pm MST."
[Charybdia] Seems like a pretty underwhelming free gift. Also Halloween sale? Never heard of Halloween as being an excuse to have a sale.
